name: pg_recall_guard
abstract: Watch vector indexes for recall drift against a baseline you approved
description: pg_recall_guard measures the recall of a vector index against exact ground truth, records the number you accepted as good, and reports when it drifts — a degraded ANN index otherwise just returns fewer of the right neighbours with no error. It finds indexes through a catalog property, so one neutral tool covers hnsw, ivfflat, diskann, gist and spgist without favouring any extension.

pg_recall_guard.abstract: Measure and watch recall of any PostgreSQL vector index
